subject: MAP: legal redlines & ownership — action roster and TAT
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finexa.com>, Tom Harris <tharris@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: legal redlines & ownership — action roster and TAT

Hi Elena / Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed owners for the MAP milestone focused on contract items (MSA / DPA / SLA). Please review and confirm whether these owners and target turnaround-times (TAT) look good on your side.

Attached: MAP_v1.2.docx (current milestone table), Finexa_redlines_20261127.pdf (your annotated copy)

Summary of ask
- Goal: Agree on who will own initial redlines and subsequent turnarounds for MSA, DPA, and SLA so we can target a signed order by 2026-12-15.
- Dependencies: Finexa exec approval on data residency (item 3), procurement timeline for PO, and legal availability for review.

Proposed roster (please confirm):
- Finexa legal: provide initial annotated redlines for MSA/DPA within 5 business days (you already shared a scan — thanks).
- Redwood legal (primary): produce counter-redlines within 4 business days after receiving Finexa annotated PDF.
- Redwood commercial (Ben): align commercial exceptions, escalate non-standard SLAs to leadership within 48 hours of redline receipt.
- Owner for SLA metric negotiation: Stephanie (works with infra to confirm latency/uptime language).

Suggested communications cadence
- Legal handback: email thread with redline PDF + one-line summary of key asks.
- Weekly sync: 30 min on Tuesdays during negotiation window (start next week if helpful).

Potential blockers we flagged on the call
- Data residency clause: Finexa may require EU-only keys for some users — needs confirmation by 2026-12-01.
- SLA financials: Finexa requested specific credit formula tied to p99 — Redwood needs infra runbook to confirm feasibility (Stephanie will validate).

Next steps (please reply with confirmations):
1) Elena / Tom: confirm Finexa legal lead and expected date for annotated MSA/DPA (can be a range).
2) Ben / Stephanie: confirm we can deliver counter-redlines TATs above.
3) Agree on weekly negotiation cadence if needed.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP doc in Drive after you confirm owners.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: MAP_v1.2.docx (DOCX)]
From: Tom Harris <tharris@finexa.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@finexa.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: legal redlines & ownership — action roster and TAT

Thanks Jasmine — quick confirmation from our side.

1) Finexa legal lead will be Maria Ortega (maria.ortega@finexa.com). She’s swamped this week but can turn around annotated MSA/DPA by 2026-12-03 EOD (5 business days as proposed). I’ve included procurement for PO timing.
2) We agree Redwood produces counter-redlines; 4 business days sounds reasonable.
3) Weekly 30-min sync on Tuesdays works; start 2026-12-01 at 10am PT.

Notes / clarifications:
- The data residency requirement is internal to Finexa and we’ll confirm (Maria will flag if EU-only keys are needed).
- Regarding SLA: procurement wants clear credit caps and definition of incident severity. We’ll raise formal questions in Maria’s annotated PDF.

Attached: (placeholder) — we will share Maria’s annotated PDF by 2026-12-03.

Tom
VP, Product — Finexa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@finexa.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@finexa.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: legal redlines & ownership — action roster and TAT

Appreciate the clear timeline, Tom. Quick internal confirmation from Redwood legal/commercial POV:
- Redwood legal (me + external counsel on standby) will prioritize the counter-redlines within 4 business days after Maria’s file. If we hit holidays or extended asks we’ll call it out immediately.
- For any novel security/data residency asks that affect architecture (e.g., EU-only KMS), we’ll need 2 business days from infra to provide impact + recommended text. Stephanie — can you confirm that cadence?

On SLA credits: I’ll prepare a short proposal outlining credit tiers and monetary caps for common incident severities and share before our first weekly sync so Finexa procurement has something concrete to react to.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_SLA_annotated.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: legal redlines & ownership — action roster and TAT

Confirmed — infra and SRE will prioritize an impact assessment on the data residency ask. Commit to delivering a recommended SLA wording and technical caveats within 2 business days after we see Maria’s annotated redlines. If the ask requires architectural changes (e.g., segregated keys or regional-only data paths), I’ll flag the estimated delivery and cost impact in the assessment.

I’ll also prepare a short appendix describing how Redwood’s caching and prefix/KV controls affect RTO/RPO language so legal has context.

Stephanie Nguyen
